suicidal behavior in children and teenagers with endogenous psychiatric disorder is associated with the presence of delusion, psychopathy, and obsessive personality disorder.

the problem of suicidal behavior in children and adolescent with endogenous psychiatric diseases.
the study of the clinical features of suicidal behavior in children with endogenous psychiatric disorder and their role in the development of suicidal behavior.

suicidal behavior in children and adolescence with endogenous disorders has a complex pathophysiological nature.

suicidal behavior is a serious problem in children and adolescents and that its prevention requires a complex approach.

the development of suicidal behavior in children and teenagers with endogenous psychoses is associated with a number of risk factors that can be identified in the course of the clinical examination and that allow to differentiate therapeutic approaches and to predict the course and the outcome of the suicidal process.
